summary.text: Tom Noret is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 25 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 1, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In the 2021-2022 legislative session Noret was first vice chair of the Conduct Committee and second vice chair of the Oversight Committee, and was also assigned to the House Education Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
